title: The diversity bound for large intersecting families
statement:
Let $\mathcal{F}\subset\binom{[n]}{k}$ be an intersecting family, where $n>100k$, and suppose that

$$
|\mathcal{F}|>\binom{n-3}{k-3}.
$$

Here $\varrho(\mathcal{F})$ denotes the diversity of $\mathcal{F}$. **The diversity bound conjecture.** Then

$$
\varrho(\mathcal{F})\geq\frac{3}{7}.
$$

This is posed as a challenging open problem concerning improved lower bounds on the diversity of large intersecting families. Its resolution is left open in the source.
source_name: Peter Frankl and Jian Wang, “Improved bounds on the maximum diversity of intersecting families”, arXiv:2304.11089 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.11089

Status: **open** according to the source (as of April 2023). “Let us conclude this paper by a challenging open problem.”
